Subject: MAP alignment: observability retention + premium support bundle — proposed ramp & commit schedule

Hi Hannah — thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Per our agreement, I attached an updated mutual action plan (MAP_v3.xlsx) and a short addendum that outlines the observability retention and premium support bundle options. High-level summary below and asks at the end.

Summary (proposed):
- Evaluation phase (2 weeks): pilot on 2 production routes, up to 50k tokens/day. Redwood provides monitoring dashboard access and 14-day observability retention included.
- Ramp phase (month 1–3): increase to 300k tokens/day with dedicated burst capacity; recommended commit: 3-month ramp with an initial committed baseline at month 2.
- Production commit: 6–12 month option, tiered discounts based on committed monthly token volume.

Bundle options (what changed vs earlier draft):
- Observability retention: standard 14-day included; add-on tiers: 60-day (+$2k/mo), 180-day (+$5k/mo) with log export SLA and longer retention in Console.
- Premium Support: included for Dedicated at Gold level; for hosted evaluation we can offer a temporary support credit pool (40 credits) to use for priority triage incidents during the eval window.
- Credits & add-ons: one-time observability migration credit (5k tokens equivalent) and evaluation credits that can convert to production credits at close.

Proposed MAP milestones (dates are placeholders — we can move to fit your procurement window):
- 07/06: Sign-off on MAP and data/security checklist completion
- 07/10: Pilot start (2 routes)
- 07/24: Ramp review & commit recommendation
- 08/07: Finalize commercial terms + DocuSign

Asks:
1) Can you confirm procurement lead and target PO/contract timeline?
2) Which observability retention tier would WorkHealth prefer for production (14/60/180)?
3) Do you want the support credit pool converted into a permanent support addon after close?

Tessa / team — ran the numbers with Finance after Hannah's note. Key points and suggested commercial language for the one-pager Rebecca asked for:

Pricing bullets to include in one-pager (net-new):
- Observability 60-day retention: +$1,950/mo fixed (no ingestion cap change for the first 6 months).
- Observability 180-day retention: +$4,750/mo fixed (ingestion tiers apply after 1TB/month).
- Support credit pool (eval): 40 credits, each credit = 30 min priority triage; unused credits expire at the end of the eval unless converted at close (conversion rate: 1 credit = $125 of support value).
- Early ramp discount: if WorkHealth hits 75% of target ramp (300k tokens/day average) within first 30 days of ramp, apply 10% credit against month 2 invoice.
- Commit discounts: 6-month commit = 8% discount; 12-month commit = 14% discount (applies to token unit rate only).

Contract mechanics suggestion (for likely redlines):
- Add an observability addendum that lists retention tier selection and auto-renewal terms.
- Include conversion clause for eval credits in the MAP: if customer signs within 30 days of pilot completion, 50% of unused eval credits convert to production support credits.

Attachments: small price table and suggested one-pager (attached here for review).

If we keep the pilot start the week of July 13, we can hit the 08/07 sign date if procurement moves quickly. Recommend Tessa send a short one-pager by EOD to Rebecca and cc procurement.
